zh.name: 盖可
zh.description: 西海岸小伙“盖可”随身带着一群调皮捣蛋的小怪兽。这些小跟班们负责冲在战斗的最前方，给敌人制造各种麻烦。等到盖可追上来后，它们还能回到他身边，然后再次出击。

en.name: Gekko
en.description: Gekko the Angeleno leads a tight-knit crew of calamitous creatures. His buddies bound forward, scattering enemies out of the way, with Gekko chasing them down to regroup and go again.

zh.name: 顽皮搭档
zh.description:
【装备】可被摧毁的宠物<whitebold>皮蛋</>。按【射击】将其放出。皮蛋会<debuffred>追击</>看到的首名敌人，并在碰撞时造成<debuffred>震荡</>。按【辅助射击】派<whitebold>皮蛋</>前往指定的爆能器部署区，部署或拆除爆能器。

技能失效后，皮蛋将变回<whitebold>球体</>。

en.name: Wingman
en.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Wingman</>. FIRE to send it forward. <debuffred>Chases</> the first enemy it sees, <debuffred>concussing</> on impact. ALT FIRE to have <whitebold>Wingman</> plant or defuse at a targeted bomb site.

Reverts to a <whitebold>Globule</>.

zh.name: 炫晕光波
zh.description:
【装备】可被摧毁的宠物<whitebold>丢丢</>。按【射击】将其掷出。丢丢会向视线内的敌人发射电浆，将其<debuffred>致盲</>。

技能失效后，丢丢将变回<whitebold>球体</>。

en.name: Dizzy
en.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Dizzy</>. FIRE to throw. Fires plasma at enemies in line of sight, <debuffred>blinding</> them.

Reverts to a <whitebold>Globule</>.

zh.name: 嗨爆全场
zh.description:
【装备】宠物<whitebold>嗨宝</>。按【射击】将其掷出。按【辅助射击】可轻抛。落地后，嗨宝会生成一片区域，持续造成少量<debuffred>伤害</>，随后爆炸，对其中的所有玩家造成大量<debuffred>伤害</>。

技能失效后，嗨宝将变回<whitebold>球体</>。

en.name: Mosh Pit
en.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Mosh</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. On landing, create a zone that deals low <debuffred>damage</> over time before exploding, dealing high <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

Reverts to a <whitebold>Globule</>.

zh.name: 无敌超鲨
zh.description:
【装备】可被摧毁的宠物<whitebold>鲨鲨</>。按【射击】进行操控。再次按【射击】可让鲨鲨向前冲刺并爆炸，<debuffred>束缚</>范围内的所有玩家。冲刺期间按【射击】可提前引爆。

鲨鲨只能变回<whitebold>球体</>一次。

en.name: Thrash
en.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Thrash</>. FIRE to take control. FIRE again to lunge and explode, <debuffred>detaining</> all players. FIRE while lunging to explode early.

Reverts to a <whitebold>Globule</> only once.

zh.name: 球体回收
zh.description:
盖可的技能在使用后会变为<whitebold>球体</>。

与附近的<whitebold>球体</>【互动】即可将其回收，短暂冷却后可再次获得充能。

en.name: Globule
en.description:
Gekko’s abilities transform into a <whitebold>Globule</> after use.

INTERACT to reclaim nearby <whitebold>Globules</> to gain another charge after a short cooldown.

zh.name: 黑梦
zh.description: “黑梦”是来自小亚细亚地区的赏金猎人，她能够操纵纯粹的噩梦能量，揭开他人心底潜藏的恐惧和秘密。她会如梦魇般对敌人穷追不舍，然后在黑暗中将其摧毁殆尽。

en.name: Fade
en.description: Turkish bounty hunter Fade unleashes the power of raw nightmare to seize enemy secrets. Attuned with terror itself, she hunts down targets and reveals their deepest fears - before crushing them in the dark.

zh.name: 幽爪
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>幽爪</>。按【射击】将其掷出。【再次激活】可使其提前下落。落地后，<debuffred>捆缚</>敌人，并对其施加<debuffred>致聋</>和<debuffred>腐坏</>效果。

en.name: Seize
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Seize</>. FIRE to throw. REACTIVATE to drop early. On landing, <debuffred>deafen</>, <debuffred>decay</>, and <debuffred>tether</> enemies.

zh.name: 诡眼
zh.description: 【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>诡眼</>。按【射击】将其掷出。【再次激活】可使其提前下落。落地后，<debuffred>标记</>并<debuffred>揭露</>技能范围及其视线范围内的所有敌人。

en.name: Haunt
en.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Haunt</>. FIRE to throw. REACTIVATE to drop early. On landing, <debuffred>mark</> and <debuffred>reveal</> enemies in range and line of sight.

zh.name: 黯兽
zh.description: 【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>黯兽</>。按【射击】将其放出。【按住射击】可使其朝你准星的方向移动。黯兽会<debuffred>追击</>看到的首名敌人或追踪<whitebold>魇迹</>，并在碰撞时造成<debuffred>视野收缩</>。

en.name: Prowler
en.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Prowler</>. FIRE to send it forward. HOLD FIRE to steer towards your crosshair. <debuffred>Chases</> the first enemy or <whitebold>Terror Trail</> it sees, <debuffred>nearsighting</> on impact.

zh.name: 夜临
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>夜临</>。按【射击】向前释放一道能量波，<debuffred>标记</>敌人，并对其施加<debuffred>致聋</>和<debuffred>腐坏</>效果。

en.name: Nightfall
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Nightfall</>. FIRE to send forward a wave that <debuffred>deafens</>, <debuffred>decays</>, and <debuffred>marks</> enemies.

zh.name: 魇迹
zh.description: <debuffred>被标记</>的敌人会被<whitebold>魇迹</>追踪位置。

en.name: Terror Trails
en.description: <debuffred>Marked</> enemies have their location tracked by <whitebold>Terror Trails</>.

zh.name: 铁臂
zh.description: 生化改造人“铁臂”来自北欧波罗的海西岸，他能够使用定向爆破和动能冲击从敌阵中强行打开一条通道。他从来不跟敌人讲道理，火力和爆破就是硬道理。

en.name: Breach
en.description: The bionic Swede Breach fires powerful, targeted kinetic blasts to aggressively clear a path through enemy ground. The damage and disruption he inflicts ensures no fight is ever fair.

zh.name: 闪点爆破
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>闪点爆破</>。按【射击】可透过墙壁引发一次爆破，<debuffred>致盲</>所有目击爆破点的玩家。

en.name: Flashpoint
en.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>Flashpoint</>. FIRE to send it through a wall, exploding to <debuffred>flash</> all players looking at it.

zh.name: 山崩地陷
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>山崩地陷</>。【按住射击】可增加射程。【松开】可引爆一片区域，使范围内的所有玩家受到<debuffred>震荡</>。

en.name: Fault Line
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Fault Line</>. HOLD FIRE to increase distance. RELEASE to detonate a zone that <debuffred>concusses</> all players.

zh.name: 剧震余波
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>剧震余波</>。按【射击】可透过墙壁引发一次爆破，对范围内的所有玩家造成大量<debuffred>伤害</>。

en.name: Aftershock
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Aftershock</>. FIRE to send a zone through a wall, exploding to repeatedly deal <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

zh.name: 惊雷卷地
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>惊雷卷地</>。按【射击】向前释放一道地震波，<debuffred>击飞</>和<debuffred>震荡</>范围内的所有玩家。

en.name: Rolling Thunder
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Rolling Thunder</>. FIRE to send forward a wave that <debuffred>concusses</> and <debuffred>knocks up</> all players.

zh.name: 钢锁
zh.description: 来自北欧的特工“钢锁”配备着多种尖端纳米纤维武器，她擅长监听战场动态和阻碍对手移动。一旦敌人遭到锁定，将面对她凌厉无情的攻势并难逃一劫。

en.name: Deadlock
en.description: Norwegian operative Deadlock deploys an array of cutting-edge nanowire to secure the battlefield from even the most lethal assault. No one escapes her vigilant watch, nor survives her unyielding ferocity.

zh.name: 声感陷阱
zh.description:
【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>声感陷阱</>。按【射击】进行部署。探测到附近敌人发出的噪音时触发，生成一片区域，对其中的所有玩家造成<debuffred>震荡</>效果。<whitebold>声感陷阱</>会在放置后进入<teal>隐形</>状态。

此道具可以被回收。

en.name: Sonic Sensor
en.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Sonic Sensor</>. FIRE to place. Triggers on nearby detected enemy noise, creating a zone that <debuffred>concusses</> all players. <whitebold>Sonic Sensor</> <teal>stealths</> after placement.

Can be picked up.

zh.name: 阻域屏障
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>阻域屏障</>。按【射击】将其掷出。落地后，生成可被摧毁的节点，并在短暂延迟后加固。这些节点会形成屏障，阻挡玩家移动。

en.name: Barrier Mesh
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Barrier Mesh</>. FIRE to throw. On landing, create destructible markers that fortify after a delay. These markers form barriers that block player movement.

zh.name: 重力捕网
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>重力捕网</>。按【射击】将其掷出。按【辅助射击】可轻抛。落地时爆炸，迫使范围内的所有玩家<debuffred>蹲伏</>并<debuffred>减慢</>移动速度，持续至移除捕网为止。

en.name: GravNet
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>GravNet</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. Explodes on landing, forcing all players to <debuffred>crouch</> and move <debuffred>slowly</> until they remove the net.

zh.name: 断魂索道
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>断魂索道</>。按【射击】释放进行捕获，将命中的首个敌人包裹在一个可被摧毁的茧里，并拖拽目标沿一条索道移动。如果茧没有被摧毁，目标将受到<debuffred>致命伤害</>。

en.name: Annihilation
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Annihilation</>. FIRE to launch a zone, forcing the first enemy caught into a destructible cocoon that pulls them along a path for <debuffred>lethal damage</> unless the cocoon is destroyed.

zh.name: 钛狐
zh.description: “钛狐”是来自南美洲的资深情报顾问。他的弹道制导系统可以向敌人施压，迫使其做出选择——要么放弃阵地，要么放弃生命。受到精准打击后，对手往往会失去平衡，被他轻易击败。

en.name: Tejo
en.description: A veteran intelligence consultant from Colombia, Tejo’s ballistic guidance system pressures the enemy to relinquish their ground - or their lives. His targeted strikes keep opponents off balance and under his heel.

zh.name: 精准投放
zh.description: 【装备】战术地图。按【射击】设定位置。按【辅助射击】发射导弹，导弹抵达目标位置后持续释放脉冲，对范围内的所有玩家造成<debuffred>伤害</>。

en.name: Guided Salvo
en.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set locations. ALT FIRE to launch missiles that travel to and repeatedly pulse, dealing <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

zh.name: 特快专递
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>特快专递</>。按【射击】发射。按【辅助射击】发射并使其弹跳一次。触碰到任意表面后爆炸，<debuffred>震荡</>范围内的所有玩家并<debuffred>造成伤害</>。

en.name: Special Delivery
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Special Delivery</>. FIRE to launch. ALT FIRE to launch with a bounce. Explodes on any surface, <debuffred>concussing</> and <debuffred>damaging</> all players.

zh.name: 末日审判
zh.description: 【装备】战术地图。按【射击】设置起点，调整方向后再次按【射击】，即可释放一道冲击波，对范围内的所有玩家造成大量<debuffred>伤害</>。按【辅助射击】可取消瞄准。

en.name: Armageddon
en.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set, pivot and FIRE again to cast a wave that deals high <debuffred>damage</> to all players. ALT FIRE to cancel targeting.

zh.name: 潜袭爬虫
zh.description: 【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>潜袭爬虫</>。按【射击】进行操控。再次按【射击】，可<debuffred>揭露</>并<debuffred>压制</>技能范围及其视线范围内的附近敌人。

en.name: Stealth Drone
en.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Stealth Drone</>. FIRE to take control. FIRE again to <debuffred>reveal</> and <debuffred>suppress</> nearby enemies in range and line of sight.

zh.name: 雷兹
zh.description: “雷兹”来自亚马逊平原。她轰轰烈烈的性情就跟她手中的武器一样火爆，作战风格也是简单粗暴、爆发力十足。无论是攻坚战还是狭小空间的遭遇战，都是她的拿手好戏。

en.name: Raze
en.description: Raze explodes out of Brazil with her big personality and big guns. With her blunt-force-trauma playstyle, she excels at flushing entrenched enemies and clearing tight spaces with a generous dose of "boom."

zh.name: 惊喜翻腾
zh.description:
【立即】投掷可被摧毁的<whitebold>惊喜翻腾</>，可粘附在物体表面，并在短暂延迟后完全就绪。【再次激活】即可将其引爆，<debuffred>击退</>命中的所有目标。

完全就绪后，<whitebold>惊喜翻腾</>还会对敌人造成<debuffred>伤害</>。

en.name: Blast Pack
en.description:
INSTANTLY throw a destructible <whitebold>Blast Pack</> that sticks to surfaces that fully arms after a delay. REACTIVATE to detonate, <debuffred>knocking away</> anything hit.

If fully armed, <whitebold>Blast Pack</> will also deal <debuffred>damage</> to enemies.

zh.name: 彩雷飞溅
zh.description:
【装备】<whitebold>彩雷飞溅</>。按【射击】将其掷出。按【辅助射击】可轻抛。短暂延迟后爆炸，造成<debuffred>伤害</>并生成子榴弹，每颗子榴弹也会对范围内所有玩家造成<debuffred>伤害</>。

每击败两名敌人，可重置充能。

en.name: Paint Shells
en.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Paint Shells</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. After a delay, explode, dealing <debuffred>damage</> and creating sub-munitions, each also dealing <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

Resets every two kills.

zh.name: 花车巡游
zh.description: 【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>花车巡游</>。按【射击】将其放出。<debuffred>追击</>看到的首名敌人，并在碰撞时爆炸，对敌人造成<debuffred>伤害</>。

en.name: Boom Bot
en.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Boom Bot</>. FIRE to send it forward. <debuffred>Chases</> the first enemy it sees, exploding and dealing <debuffred>damage</> to enemies on impact.

zh.name: 晚安焰火
zh.description: 【立即】准备<whitebold>晚安焰火</>。按【射击】发射。触碰到任意表面后爆炸，对范围内所有玩家造成大量<debuffred>伤害</>。

en.name: Showstopper
en.description: INSTANTLY prepare <whitebold>Showstopper</>. FIRE to launch. Explodes on any surface, dealing high <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

zh.name: 尚勃勒
zh.description: 穿着考究、装备精良的西欧武器设计师“尚勃勒”非常擅长防守阵线。他会利用强大的自制武器从远处逼退妄图进犯的敌人，同时也会为自己的撤退和转移准备体面的应急方案。

en.name: Chamber
en.description: Well-dressed and well-armed, French weapons designer Chamber expels aggressors with deadly precision. He leverages his custom arsenal to hold the line and pick off enemies from afar, with a contingency built for every plan.

zh.name: 闪转自如
zh.description:
【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>闪转自如</>。按【射击】进行部署。处于范围内时，【再次激活】可立即传送到其位置。

此道具可以被召回。

en.name: Rendezvous
en.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Rendezvous</>. FIRE to place. While in range, REACTIVATE to instantly teleport to it.

Can be recalled.

zh.name: 贵宾限行
zh.description:
【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>贵宾限行</>。按【射击】进行部署。附近范围内出现可见的敌人时触发，生成一片使所有玩家<debuffred>减速</>的区域。

此道具可以被召回。

en.name: Trademark
en.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Trademark</>. FIRE to place. Triggers on nearby visible enemies in range, creating a zone that <debuffred>slows</> all players.

Can be recalled.

zh.name: 金牌猎头
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>金牌猎头</>。按【射击】开火。按【辅助射击】开镜瞄准。

en.name: Headhunter
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Headhunter</>. FIRE to shoot. ALT FIRE to aim down sights.

zh.name: 孤高火力
zh.description:
【激活】后可召唤一把狙击枪，命中上半身时可造成<debuffred>致命伤害</>。

按【射击】开火。可使用【辅助射击】开镜瞄准。击败敌人时，会生成一片使所有玩家<debuffred>减速</>的区域。

en.name: Tour De Force
en.description:
ACTIVATE to access a sniper rifle that deals <debuffred>lethal damage</> with direct hits to the upper body.

FIRE to shoot. ALT FIRE to aim down sights. On kills, create a zone that <debuffred>slows</> all players.

zh.name: K/O
zh.description: K/O是一台战争机器，他被制造出来只有一个目的：消灭源能者。他的能力可以【压制】敌人的技能，为自己与队友制造战术优势。

en.name: KAY/O
en.description: KAY/O is a machine of war built for a single purpose: neutralizing radiants. His power to Suppress enemy abilities dismantles his opponents' capacity to fight back, securing him and his allies the ultimate edge.

zh.name: 碎片溢出
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>碎片溢出</>。按【射击】将其掷出。按【辅助射击】可轻抛。落地时爆炸，持续对范围内的所有玩家造成<debuffred>伤害</>。

en.name: FRAG/ment
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>FRAG/ment</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. Explodes on landing, repeatedly dealing pulses of <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

zh.name: 闪存过载
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>闪存过载</>。按【射击】将其掷出。按【辅助射击】可轻抛。短暂延迟后引爆，<debuffred>致盲</>所有目击它的玩家。

en.name: FLASH/drive
en.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>FLASH/drive</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. After a delay, explode, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

zh.name: 零点嗅探
zh.description: 【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>零点嗅探</>。按【射击】将其掷出。触碰到任意表面后释放脉冲，<debuffred>压制</>范围内的敌人。

en.name: ZERO/point
en.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>ZERO/point</>. FIRE to throw. Pulses on any surface, <debuffred>suppressing</> enemies within range.

zh.name: 无效命令
zh.description:
【立即】进入<teal>超载状态</>并持续释放脉冲，<debuffred>压制</>范围内的敌人。

<teal>超载</>期间，获得<teal>作战强化</>状态。K/O在受到<debuffred>致命伤害</>时会被击倒，并能重启再战。

en.name: NULL/cmd
en.description:
INSTANTLY gain <teal>overloaded</> and repeatedly send out a pulse that <debuffred>suppresses</> enemies within range.

<teal>Overloaded</> grants <teal>combat stim</>. Upon taking <debuffred>lethal damage</>, KAY/O is downed and can be re-stabilized.

zh.name: 斯凯
zh.description: “斯凯”来自大洋洲，带着宠物风风火火地穿越敌人领地是她的标志风格。她不仅可以用她的造物牵制敌人，还能治疗队友，是小队中攻守兼备的一员。

en.name: Skye
en.description: Hailing from Australia, Skye and her band of beasts trailblaze the way through hostile territory. With her creations hampering the enemy, and her power to heal others, the team is strongest and safest by Skye's side.

zh.name: 辟林之虎
zh.description: 【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>辟林之虎</>。按【射击】进行操控。再次按【射击】可使其向前扑出并爆炸，<debuffred>震荡</>范围内的所有玩家，并对直接命中的敌人造成<debuffred>伤害</>。

en.name: Trailblazer
en.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Trailblazer</>. FIRE to take control. FIRE again to lunge and explode, <debuffred>concussing</> all players and dealing <debuffred>damage</> to enemies on direct hits.

zh.name: 引路之隼
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>引路之隼</>。按【射击】将其放出。【按住射击】可使其朝你准星的方向移动。【再次激活】即可将其引爆，<debuffred>致盲</>所有目击它的玩家。

en.name: Guiding Light
en.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>Guiding Light</>. FIRE to send it forward. HOLD FIRE to steer towards your crosshair. REACTIVATE to detonate, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

zh.name: 愈生之息
zh.description:
【装备】<whitebold>愈生之息</>。【按住射击】可<teal>治疗</>技能范围内且在视线内的队友。治疗池储量有限。

无法治疗自己。

en.name: Regrowth
en.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Regrowth</>. HOLD FIRE to <teal>heal</> allies in range and line of sight. Uses a limited healing pool.

Cannot heal self.

zh.name: 追猎之灵
zh.description: 【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>追猎之灵</>。按【射击】可派出最多三个<whitebold>追猎之灵</>。追猎之灵会<debuffred>追击</>距离最近的三名敌人，并在碰撞时使其<debuffred>视野收缩</>和<debuffred>减速</>。

en.name: Seekers
en.description: EQUIP destructible <whitebold>Seekers</>. FIRE to send out up to three <whitebold>Seekers</>. <debuffred>Chases</> the three closest enemies, <debuffred>nearsighting</> and <debuffred>slowing</> on impact.

zh.name: 零
zh.description: 情报贩子“零”来自直布罗陀海峡南岸，他堪比人形情报网络，紧密地监视着敌人的一举一动。在他的眼皮底下没有秘密，也没有人能瞒天过海。

en.name: Cypher
en.description: The Moroccan information broker, Cypher is a one-man surveillance network who keeps tabs on the enemy's every move. No secret is safe. No maneuver goes unseen. Cypher is always watching.

zh.name: 赛博囚笼
zh.description:
【立即】投掷一个<whitebold>赛博囚笼</>。与其【互动】可生成一片阻碍视野的圆柱体，并在敌人与其接触时发出提示音。

此道具可在【购买阶段】回收。

en.name: Cyber Cage
en.description:
INSTANTLY throw a <whitebold>Cyber Cage</>. INTERACT to create a vision-blocking cylinder that plays an audio cue when enemies come in contact.

Can be picked up during BUY PHASE.

zh.name: 战术监控
zh.description:
【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>战术监控</>。按【射击】进行部署。<whitebold>战术监控</>会在放置后进入<teal>隐形</>状态。【再次激活】可进行操控。按【射击】发射一支定位镖，<debuffred>瞬时揭露</>命中的敌人，持续至定位镖被移除为止。

此道具可以被回收。

en.name: Spycam
en.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Spycam</>. FIRE to place. <whitebold>Spycam</> <teal>stealths</> after placement. REACTIVATE to control it. FIRE to shoot a dart that <debuffred>snapshots</> enemies hit until they remove it.

Can be picked up.

zh.name: 震慑绊线
zh.description:
【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>震慑绊线</>。按【射击】可在两个物体表面之间布置一根绊线。<whitebold>震慑绊线</>会在放置后进入<teal>隐形</>状态。当敌人接触时触发，<debuffred>捆缚</>敌人，并在短暂延迟后激活，如果<whitebold>震慑绊线</>未被摧毁，则<debuffred>揭露</>敌人的位置。

此道具可以被回收。

en.name: Trapwire
en.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Trapwire</>. FIRE to place a wire between surfaces. <whitebold>Trapwire</> <teal>stealths</> after placement. Triggers when enemies come in contact, <debuffred>tethering</> enemies, and after a delay, <debuffred>revealing</> them if <whitebold>Trapwire</> is not destroyed.

Can be picked up.

zh.name: 神经取析
zh.description: 对被击败的敌方玩家【激活】。短暂延迟后，<debuffred>瞬时揭露</>存活的敌人两次。

en.name: Neural Theft
en.description: ACTIVATE on a targeted dead enemy. After a delay, <debuffred>snapshot</> living enemies twice.

zh.name: 猎枭
zh.description: ”猎枭“生长于终年严寒的北方冻原。他能够精准而高效地追踪、锁定和歼灭敌人。凭借一把特制战弓和无与伦比的侦察能力，他能让猎物无所遁形、无处可逃。

en.name: Sova
en.description: Born from the eternal winter of Russia's tundra, Sova tracks, finds, and eliminates enemies with ruthless efficiency and precision. His custom bow and incredible scouting abilities ensure that even if you run, you cannot hide.

zh.name: 雷击箭
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>雷击箭</>。按【射击】射出箭矢，箭矢在触碰到任意表面后爆炸，对范围内的所有玩家造成<debuffred>伤害</>。【按住射击】可提升箭矢速度。按【辅助射击】可增加弹跳次数，最多两次。

en.name: Shock Bolt
en.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>Shock Bolt</>. FIRE to shoot a bolt that explodes on any surface, dealing <debuffred>damage</> to all players. HOLD FIRE to increase the bolt’s velocity. ALT FIRE to add up to two bounces.

zh.name: 寻敌箭
zh.description: 【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>寻敌箭</>。按【射击】射出箭矢，持续<debuffred>揭露</>技能范围及其视线范围内的附近敌人。【按住射击】可提升箭矢速度。按【辅助射击】可增加弹跳次数，最多两次。

en.name: Recon Bolt
en.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Recon Bolt</>. FIRE to shoot a bolt that repeatedly <debuffred>reveals</> nearby enemies in range and line of sight. HOLD FIRE to increase the bolt’s velocity. ALT FIRE to add up to two bounces.

zh.name: 枭型无人机
zh.description: 【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>枭型无人机</>。按【射击】进行操控。再次按【射击】，发射一支可持续<debuffred>揭露</>敌人的定位镖。

en.name: Owl Drone
en.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Owl Drone</>. FIRE to take control. FIRE again to shoot a dart that repeatedly <debuffred>reveals</> enemies.

zh.name: 狂猎之怒
zh.description:
【装备】<whitebold>狂猎之怒</>。按【射击】向一片区域发射，造成<debuffred>伤害</>。最多可再次发射两次。

被命中的敌人会向猎枭<debuffred>揭露</>其位置。

en.name: Hunter's Fury
en.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Hunter’s Fury</>. FIRE to shoot a zone that deals <debuffred>damage</>. Can be fired up to two more times.

Enemies hit are <debuffred>revealed</> to Sova.

zh.name: 迷核
zh.description: 来自欧洲中南部的“迷核”能够操控纯粹的声波能量。凭借极具感染力的激情和独特的音波力量，他率领全队协同作战，定下战场的主导节奏。

en.name: Miks
en.description: Straight from Croatia, Miks takes the stage channeling pure sound energy. With his infectious passion and sonic powers, he rallies his squad to move as one as they set the tempo on the battlefield together.

zh.name: 电音脉冲
zh.description: 【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>电音脉冲</>。按【辅助射击】可在<debuffred>震荡</>输出与<teal>治疗</>输出之间切换。按【射击】将其掷出。落地后会持续发出脉冲，对范围内的所有玩家施加所选效果。

en.name: M-pulse
en.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>M-Pulse</>. ALT FIRE to toggle between <debuffred>concuss</> or <teal>heal</>. FIRE to throw. Repeatedly pulses on landing, applying the selected effect on all players within range.

zh.name: 声波帷幕
zh.description: 【装备】战术地图。按【射击】设定烟雾位置。按【辅助射击】施放烟雾。

en.name: Waveform
en.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set smoke locations. ALT FIRE to cast smokes.

zh.name: 共振谐律
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>共振谐律</>。瞄准一名队友并按【射击】，为你和该队友提供<teal>作战强化</>和<teal>加速</>效果。激活期间，如果两名处于<whitebold>共振谐律</>状态的玩家均存活，则每次击败敌人都会刷新<teal>增益</>效果。按【辅助射击】对自己施放，无法刷新增益效果。

en.name: Harmonize
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Harmonize</>. FIRE on a targeted ally to grant <teal>combat stim</> and <teal>haste</> to them and yourself. On kills while active, refresh the <teal>buff</> if both <whitebold>Harmonized</> players are still alive. ALT FIRE to self-cast with no refresh.

zh.name: 音脉强袭
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>音脉强袭</>。按【射击】向前释放一片区域，<debuffred>击退</>范围内的所有玩家，并对其造成<debuffred>致聋</>和<debuffred>减速</>效果。

en.name: Bassquake
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Bassquake</>. FIRE to send forward a zone that <debuffred>deafens</>, <debuffred>knocks back</>, and <debuffred>slows</> all players.

zh.name: 奇乐
zh.description: “奇乐”是来自莱茵河畔的天才发明家，她擅长使用陷阱、炮台和地雷来控制和防守战场上的关键位置。敌人若是不懂知难而退，便会发现这些装置个头虽小，制造的麻烦却很大。

en.name: Killjoy
en.description: The genius of Germany, Killjoy effortlessly secures key battlefield positions with her arsenal of inventions. If their damage doesn't take her enemies out, the debuff her robots provide will make short work of them.

zh.name: 纳米蜂群
zh.description:
【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>纳米蜂群</>。按【射击】将其掷出。按【辅助射击】可轻抛。<whitebold>纳米蜂群</>会在落地后进入<teal>隐形</>状态。与其【互动】会生成一片区域，对其中的所有玩家造成<debuffred>伤害</>。

此道具可在【购买阶段】回收。

en.name: Nanoswarm
en.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Nanoswarm</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. <whitebold>Nanoswarm</> <teal>stealths</> after landing. INTERACT to create a zone that deals <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

Can be picked up during BUY PHASE.

zh.name: 自动哨兵
zh.description:
【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>自动哨兵</>。按【射击】进行部署。<whitebold>自动哨兵</>会在放置后进入<teal>隐形</>状态。附近范围内出现可见的敌人时触发。自动哨兵会<debuffred>追击</>看到的首名敌人，引发爆炸并施加<debuffred>易伤</>效果。

此道具可以被召回。

en.name: ALARMBOT
en.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Alarmbot</>. FIRE to place. <whitebold>Alarmbot</> <teal>stealths</> after placement. Triggers on nearby visible enemies in range. <debuffred>Chases</> the first enemy it sees, exploding and applying <debuffred>vulnerable</>.

Can be recalled.

zh.name: 哨戒炮台
zh.description:
【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>哨戒炮台</>。在此期间，可【再次激活】调转方向或【按住辅助射击】进行旋转。按【射击】进行部署。炮台会向视线内的敌人射击。

此道具可以被召回。

en.name: TURRET
en.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Turret</>. While equipped, REACTIVATE to flip the direction or HOLD ALT FIRE to rotate. FIRE to place. Shoots at enemies in line of sight.

Can be recalled.

zh.name: 全面封锁
zh.description: 【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>全面封锁</>。按【射击】进行部署。延迟后，<debuffred>束缚</>范围内的敌人。

en.name: Lockdown
en.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Lockdown</>. FIRE to prepare a zone. After a delay, <debuffred>detain</> enemies within range.

zh.name: 海神
zh.description: “海神”来自印度洋沿岸，借助古代科技的力量，他能够灵活地控制水的形态，释放出激流和巨浪来保护队友或击溃敌人。

en.name: Harbor
en.description: Hailing from India’s coast, Harbor storms the field wielding ancient technology with dominion over water. He unleashes frothing rapids and crushing waves to shield his allies, or pummel those that oppose him.

zh.name: 狂潮
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>狂潮</>。按【射击】向前发射一道可阻挡视野的水墙，并使所有接触到的玩家<debuffred>减速</>。【按住射击】可使其朝你准星的方向移动。按【辅助射击】可提前中断。

en.name: High Tide
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>High Tide</>. FIRE to send forward a vision-blocking wall that <debuffred>slows</> all players who come in contact. HOLD FIRE to steer towards your crosshair. ALT FIRE to stop early.

zh.name: 乱涌
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>乱涌</>。按【射击】将其掷出。落地时爆炸，对所有玩家造成<debuffred>视野收缩</>和<debuffred>减速</>效果。

en.name: Storm Surge
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Storm Surge</>. FIRE to throw. Explodes on landing, <debuffred>nearsighting</> and <debuffred>slowing</> all players.

zh.name: 海盾
zh.description: 【进入】深海视界。【再次激活】即可释放烟雾。按住【射击】/【辅助射击】可调整距离。按【换弹】可切换视野。释放后，【再次激活】即可将烟雾转化为可被摧毁的护盾。

en.name: Cove
en.description: ENTER The Deep. REACTIVATE to cast a smoke. HOLD FIRE/ALT FIRE to adjust distance. RELOAD to toggle view. After casting, REACTIVATE to transform the smoke into a destructible shield.

zh.name: 怒涛
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>怒涛</>。按【射击】向前推出一道可阻挡视野的水墙，并使所有接触到的玩家<debuffred>视野收缩</>和<debuffred>减速</>。【再次激活】即可使水墙提前停止。

en.name: Reckoning
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Reckoning</>. FIRE to push forward a vision-blocking wall that <debuffred>nearsights</> and <debuffred>slows</> all players who come in contact. REACTIVATE to stop the wall early.

zh.name: 维斯
zh.description: “维斯”是一位高智商金属能力者。她能自由操纵液态金属的形态，为敌人设下重重陷阱和障碍，甚至解除他们的武装。敌人与她对抗，就像在与整个战场为敌。

en.name: Vyse
en.description: Metallic mastermind Vyse unleashes liquid metal to isolate, trap, and disarm her enemies. Through cunning and manipulation, she forces all who oppose her to fear the battlefield itself.

zh.name: 裁断
zh.description:
【装备】<whitebold>裁断</>。按【射击】进行部署。<whitebold>裁断</>会在放置后进入<teal>隐形</>状态。敌人经过时触发，短暂延迟后生成一道不可摧毁的墙体。

此道具可以在【购买阶段】召回。

en.name: Shear
en.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Shear</>. FIRE to place. <whitebold>Shear</> <teal>stealths</> after placement. Triggers when enemies walk on it, and after a delay, create a brief indestructible wall.

Can be recalled during BUY PHASE.

zh.name: 弧光玫瑰
zh.description:
【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>弧光玫瑰</>。按【射击】进行部署。按【辅助射击】可放置在墙的另一侧。【再次激活】可<debuffred>致盲</>所有目击它的玩家。 

此道具可以被召回。

en.name: Arc Rose
en.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Arc Rose</>. FIRE to place. ALT FIRE to place it through a wall. REACTIVATE to <debuffred>flash</> all players looking at it. 

Can be recalled.

zh.name: 剃刀藤蔓
zh.description:
【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>剃刀藤蔓</>。按【射击】将其掷出。<whitebold>剃刀藤蔓</>会在落地后进入<teal>隐形</>状态。与其【互动】会生成一片区域，对穿行的玩家造成<debuffred>伤害</>和<debuffred>减速</>。

此道具可以在【购买阶段】召回。

en.name: Razorvine
en.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Razorvine</>. FIRE to throw. <whitebold>Razorvine</> <teal>stealths</> after landing. INTERACT to create a zone that <debuffred>slows</> and deals <debuffred>damage</> when players move through it.

Can be recalled during BUY PHASE.

zh.name: 铁棘禁园
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>铁棘禁园</>。按【射击】进行部署。短暂延迟后，<debuffred>阻塞</>范围内敌人的主要武器。

en.name: Steel Garden
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Steel Garden</>. FIRE to prepare a zone. After a delay, <debuffred>jam</> enemy primary weapons within range.

zh.name: 蝰蛇
zh.description: “蝰蛇”是一位来自美洲大陆的化学家，擅长部署毒性化学装置来控制战场并削弱敌人的视野。即便猎物没倒在她的毒素之下，她也会利用心理战将其击溃。

en.name: Viper
en.description: The American Chemist, Viper deploys an array of poisonous chemical devices to control the battlefield and choke the enemy's vision. If the toxins don't kill her prey, her mindgames surely will.

zh.name: 瘴云
zh.description:
【装备】<whitebold>瘴云</>。按【射击】将其掷出。按【辅助射击】可轻抛。【再次激活】即可消耗燃料，生成一团<whitebold>有毒</>烟雾，对敌人造成<debuffred>腐坏</>效果。

此道具可在【购买阶段】回收。

en.name: Poison Cloud
en.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Poison Cloud</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. REACTIVATE to consume fuel to create a <whitebold>toxic</> smoke that <debuffred>decays</> enemies.

Can be picked up during BUY PHASE.

zh.name: 毒幕
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>毒幕</>。按【射击】向前沿直线发射并放置气雾发射器阵列。【再次激活】即可消耗燃料，生成一道可阻挡视野的<whitebold>有毒</>墙体，对敌人造成<debuffred>腐坏</>效果。

en.name: Toxic Screen
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Toxic Screen</>. FIRE to send forward and place a line of emitters. REACTIVATE to consume fuel to create a <whitebold>toxic</> vision-blocking wall that <debuffred>decays</> enemies.

zh.name: 蛇吻
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>蛇吻</>。按【射击】发射。落地后，生成一片区域，对其中的所有玩家施加<debuffred>易伤</>效果并造成少量<debuffred>伤害</>。

en.name: Snake Bite
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Snake Bite</>. FIRE to launch. On landing, create a zone that grants <debuffred>vulnerable</> and deals low <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

zh.name: 蝰腹
zh.description:
【装备】<whitebold>蝰腹</>。按【射击】生成一大片可阻挡视野的<whitebold>有毒</>气雾，并使其中的敌人受到<debuffred>腐坏</>效果。

【按住激活】可使气雾消散。

en.name: Viper's Pit
en.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Viper’s Pit</>. FIRE to form a large <whitebold>toxic</> vision-blocking cloud that <debuffred>decays</> enemies inside.

HOLD ACTIVATE to cancel the cloud.

zh.name: 虺毒
zh.description: 蝰蛇的<whitebold>药剂</>会对接触到的敌人持续造成<debuffred>腐坏</>效果。燃料会随时间自动恢复。

en.name: Toxin
en.description: Viper’s <whitebold>Toxin</> continuously inflicts <debuffred>decay</> when enemies come in contact. Passively recharge fuel over time.

zh.name: 遐思
zh.description: 来自岭南的特工“遐思”身怀念力异能，专长于处理异常事务。她的战斗风格极具技巧性和想象力，能让战术道具在半空中转向，对敌方小队造成干扰或迫使其移动，甚至能让对手悬空而失去抵抗能力。

en.name: Hush
en.description: Chinese operative Hush uses her telekinesis to close the most classified cases. Fighting with precision and finesse, she redirects her combat utility in midair to disrupt and displace the enemy team before suspending them helplessly for the killing blow.

zh.name: 灵光一念
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>灵光一念</>。按【射击】将其掷出。按【辅助射击】进行准备。【再次激活】使其朝你的准星位置移动。此道具会在接触到任何表面后或在一段延迟后爆炸，<debuffred>致盲</>所有目击它的玩家。

en.name: Flashbulb
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Flashbulb</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to prepare it instead. REACTIVATE to direct it towards your crosshair. Explodes on any surface or after a delay, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

zh.name: 念落星移
zh.description:
【装备】<whitebold>念落星移</>。按【射击】将其掷出。按【辅助射击】进行准备。【再次激活】使其朝你的准星位置移动。此道具会在接触到任何表面后或在一段延迟后爆炸，将其中的玩家<debuffred>拉向</>其中心；若玩家与任意表面或其他玩家相撞，还会受到<debuffred>震荡</>。

每击败两名敌人，可重置充能。

en.name: Displacement
en.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Displacement</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to prepare it instead. REACTIVATE to direct it towards your crosshair. Explodes on any surface or after a delay, <debuffred>pulling</> all players towards the center and <debuffred>concussing</> them if they collide with any surface or another player.

Resets every two kills.

zh.name: 身随念动
zh.description: 【立即】创造一个锚点。如果遐思位于空中，将短暂在原地悬浮。短暂延迟后，飞向锚点。

en.name: Flow
en.description: INSTANTLY create an anchor. If Hush is in the air, briefly levitate in place. After a delay, propel towards it.

zh.name: 万念皆空
zh.description: 【立即】准备<whitebold>万念皆空</>。按【射击】将其放出，期间可使用准星进行引导。【再次激活】或再次按【射击】引爆，使所有玩家<debuffred>悬浮</>。

en.name: Suspension
en.description: INSTANTLY prepare <whitebold>Suspension</>. FIRE to send it forward, steering with your crosshair. REACTIVATE or press FIRE again to detonate, <debuffred>levitating</> all players.

zh.name: 念力
zh.description: 遐思可以从更远处拾取武器、爆能器或与开关【互动】。

en.name: Telekinesis
en.description: Hush can pick up weapons, the Spike, and INTERACT with switches from an increased range.

zh.name: 不死鸟
zh.description: 来自不列颠群岛的“不死鸟”举手投足中无处不洋溢着大牌明星风范，他就像一团耀眼的烈焰，动辄燃遍全场。对他来说，有没有后援不重要，冲锋陷阵时的派头更重要。

en.name: Phoenix
en.description: Hailing from the U.K., Phoenix's star power shines through in his fighting style, igniting the battlefield with flash and flare. Whether he's got backup or not, he's rushing in to fight on his own terms.

zh.name: 火冒三丈
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>火冒三丈</>。按【射击】向前发射一道可阻挡视野的<whitebold>火焰</>墙，对穿过它的所有玩家造成<debuffred>伤害</>。【按住射击】可使其朝你准星的方向移动。

en.name: Blaze
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Blaze</>. FIRE to send forward a vision-blocking <whitebold>fire</> wall that deals <debuffred>damage</> to all players. HOLD FIRE to steer towards your crosshair.

zh.name: 火热手感
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>火热手感</>。按【射击】将其掷出。按【辅助射击】可轻抛。落地后，生成一片<whitebold>火焰</>区域，对其中的所有玩家造成<debuffred>伤害</>。

en.name: Hot Hands
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Hot Hands</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. On landing, create a <whitebold>fire</> zone that deals <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

zh.name: 闪光曲球
zh.description:
【装备】<whitebold>闪光曲球</>。按【射击】投掷左曲球，按【辅助射击】投掷右曲球。短暂延迟后引爆，<debuffred>致盲</>所有目击它的玩家。

每击败两名敌人，可重置充能。

en.name: Curveball
en.description:
EQUIP a <whitebold>Curveball</>. FIRE to curve left, ALT FIRE to curve right. After a delay, explode, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

Resets every two kills.

zh.name: 再火一回
zh.description: 【立即】在当前位置放置标记。在受到<debuffred>致命伤害</>或<whitebold>再火一回</>结束时，返回标记位置满血重生，且保留技能激活时的护甲值。

en.name: Run it Back
en.description: INSTANTLY place a marker at your location. Upon taking <debuffred>lethal damage</> or when <whitebold>Run it Back</> expires, return to the marker with full health and the amount of armor you had when the ability was activated.

zh.name: 心火不熄
zh.description: 不死鸟处于自己创造的<whitebold>火焰</>中时，不仅不会受到伤害，反而会获得<teal>治疗</>。

en.name: Inner Fire
en.description: Phoenix <teal>heals</> while standing in his own <whitebold>fire</> instead of taking damage.

zh.name: 禁灭
zh.description: 来自西非的“禁灭”是一名压制型英雄，因基因突变获得了超凡力量。禁灭打破了既有的战斗规则，无论敌人使出怎样的手段和科技，在他面前都形同虚设。禁灭出现在战场上时，只有枪法才是你唯一的保障。

en.name: Veto
en.description: Empowered by an unstoppable DNA mutation, Senegalese enforcer Veto defies the rules of engagement by nullifying his opponent's powers and technology. On Veto's battlefield, gunplay is your only guarantee.

zh.name: 噬源体
zh.description:
【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>噬源体</>。按【射击】进行部署。【再次激活】即可激活。激活后，摧毁一切可以被射击或能从玩家身上弹开的敌方装置，仅对技能范围及其视线范围内的装置生效。

此道具可以被召回。

en.name: Interceptor
en.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Interceptor</>. FIRE to place. REACTIVATE to activate. While active, destroy any enemy utility that can be shot or would bounce off players in range and line of sight.

Can be recalled.

zh.name: 涡流折跃
zh.description:
【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>涡流折跃</>。按【射击】进行部署。处于范围内时，与其【互动】可传送到其位置。

此道具可以在【购买阶段】召回。

en.name: Crosscut
en.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Crosscut</>. FIRE to place. While in range, INTERACT to teleport to it.

Can be recalled during BUY PHASE.

zh.name: 完全进化
zh.description:
【立即】进入<teal>进化</>状态。

<teal>进化</>状态会提供<teal>作战强化</>、持续<teal>治疗</>，并使你<teal>免疫</>除武器外的减益效果和伤害。

en.name: Evolution
en.description:
INSTANTLY gain <teal>evolution</>.

<teal>Evolution</> grants <teal>combat stim</>, continuous <teal>healing</>, and <teal>immunity</> to all debuffs and damage, except weapons.

zh.name: 裂变残片
zh.description:
【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>裂变残片</>。按【射击】将其掷出。<whitebold>裂变残片</>会在落地后进入<teal>隐形</>状态。附近范围内出现可见的敌人时触发，<debuffred>捆缚</>敌人，并对其施加<debuffred>致聋</>和<debuffred>腐坏</>效果。

此道具可以在【购买阶段】召回。

en.name: Chokehold
en.description:
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Chokehold</>. FIRE to throw. <whitebold>Chokehold</> <teal>stealths</> after landing. Triggers on nearby visible enemies in range, <debuffred>deafening</>, <debuffred>decaying</>, and <debuffred>tethering</> enemies.

Can be recalled during BUY PHASE.

zh.name: 星礈
zh.description: 来自非洲大陆的“星礈”可以操控宇宙能量来重塑战场。她可以进入星界形态，以超脱凡界的战略眼光洞悉战场，抢在敌人行动之前便占得先机。

en.name: Astra
en.description: Ghanaian Agent Astra harnesses the energies of the cosmos to reshape battlefields to her whim. With full command of her astral form and a talent for deep strategic foresight, she's always eons ahead of her enemy's next move.

zh.name: 新星脉冲
zh.description: 【激活】一颗<whitebold>星体</>，将其引爆，对所有被命中的玩家造成<debuffred>震荡</>效果。

en.name: Nova Pulse
en.description: ACTIVATE a <whitebold>Star</> to detonate it, <debuffred>concussing</> all players hit.

zh.name: 星云
zh.description: 【激活】一颗<whitebold>星体</>，将其转化为烟雾。

en.name: Nebula
en.description: ACTIVATE a <whitebold>Star</> to transform it into a smoke.

zh.name: 重力之阱
zh.description: 【激活】一颗<whitebold>星体</>，生成一片区域，处于该区域的所有玩家会被<debuffred>拉向</>中心点，随后爆炸并对陷入其中的所有玩家施加<debuffred>易伤</>效果。

en.name: Gravity Well
en.description: ACTIVATE a <whitebold>Star</> to create a zone that <debuffred>pulls</> all players to the center, exploding and applying <debuffred>vulnerable</> to all players.

zh.name: 宇宙分裂
zh.description: 【进入】<whitebold>星界形态</>。按【辅助射击】以【装备】<whitebold>宇宙分裂</>。按【射击】设置起点，调整方向后再次按【射击】，即可生成一道无法被摧毁且能阻隔声音的墙体。

en.name: Cosmic Divide
en.description: ENTER <whitebold>Astral Form</>. ALT FIRE to EQUIP <whitebold>Cosmic Divide</>. FIRE to set, pivot and FIRE again to create an indestructible wall that blocks audio.

zh.name: 星界形态
zh.description:
【激活终极技能】以【进入】<whitebold>星界形态</>。按【射击】来施放<whitebold>星体</>。 

与<whitebold>星体</>【互动】可将其召回。召回<whitebold>星体</>时将生成一道短暂存在的烟雾。

en.name: Astral Form
en.description:
ACTIVATE ULTIMATE to ENTER <whitebold>Astral Form</>. FIRE to cast <whitebold>Stars</>. 

INTERACT to recall a <whitebold>Star</>. Recalling a <whitebold>Star</> forms a brief smoke.

zh.name: 炼狱
zh.description: “炼狱”来自美洲大陆，他能使用各种轨道武器来为团队提供精确支援和创造战术优势，是前线指挥官的不二人选。

en.name: Brimstone
en.description: Joining from the U.S.A., Brimstone's orbital arsenal ensures his squad always has the advantage. His ability to deliver utility precisely and safely make him the unmatched boots-on-the-ground commander.

zh.name: 振奋信标
zh.description: 【立即】投掷一个<whitebold>振奋信标</>。落地后，生成一片区域，为其中的队友提供<teal>作战强化</>和<teal>加速</>效果。

en.name: Stim Beacon
en.description: INSTANTLY throw a <whitebold>Stim Beacon</>. On landing, create a zone that grants <teal>combat stim</> and <teal>haste</> to allies.

zh.name: 燃烧榴弹
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>燃烧榴弹</>。按【射击】发射。落地后，生成一片区域，对其中的所有玩家造成<debuffred>伤害</>。

en.name: Incendiary
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Incendiary</>. FIRE to launch. On landing, create a zone that deals <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

zh.name: 空投烟幕
zh.description: 【装备】战术地图。按【射击】设定烟雾位置。按【辅助射击】施放烟雾。

en.name: Sky Smoke
en.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set smoke locations. ALT FIRE to cast smokes.

zh.name: 天基光束
zh.description: 【装备】战术地图。按【射击】向目标位置释放<whitebold>天基光束</>，持续对所有玩家造成大量<debuffred>伤害</>。

en.name: Orbital Strike
en.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to cast an <whitebold>Orbital Strike</> at a location, dealing high <debuffred>damage</> over time to all players.

zh.name: 壹决
zh.description: “壹决”是华夏文明的后裔。他是枪斗的艺术家，战斗时仿佛沉浸在自我的心流中，将对手的抵抗悉数瓦解。他还能重构环境中的能量来阻挡子弹。战斗中的他时刻保持专注，并渴望与强敌一决高下。

en.name: Iso
en.description: Chinese fixer for hire Iso falls into a flow state to dismantle the opposition. Reconfiguring ambient energy into bulletproof protection, he advances with focus towards his next duel to the death.

zh.name: 稳态剥离
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>稳态剥离</>。按【射击】将其放出。对范围内的所有玩家施加<debuffred>压制</>和<debuffred>易伤</>效果。

en.name: Undercut
en.description: EQUIP an <whitebold>Undercut</>. FIRE to send it forward. Applies <debuffred>suppress</> and <debuffred>vulnerable</> to all players.

zh.name: 决斗通牒
zh.description:
【装备】<whitebold>决斗通牒</>。按【射击】向前释放一片区域，将你和命中的首名敌人拉入一场一对一的决斗。

在决斗开始时集中意念，进入<whitebold>心流</>状态。

en.name: Kill Contract
en.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Kill Contract</>. FIRE to send forward a zone that pulls you and the first enemy hit into a duel.

Channel <whitebold>Focus</> at the start of a duel.

zh.name: 战斗心流
zh.description: 【立即】集中意念，进入<whitebold>心流</>状态。获得一道可抵挡一次伤害的护盾。

en.name: Double Tap
en.description: INSTANTLY channel <whitebold>Focus</>. Gain a shield that blocks one instance of damage.

zh.name: 绝对屏障
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>绝对屏障</>。按【射击】向前推出一道不可被摧毁、可阻挡视野的墙体。按【辅助射击】可推出速度更慢的墙体。

en.name: Contingency
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Contingency</>. FIRE to push forward an indestructible vision-blocking wall. ALT FIRE for a slower wall.

zh.name: 战斗心流
zh.description:
在<whitebold>心流</>状态下，壹决以更快速度装弹，且受到其伤害或被其击败的敌人会生成可摧毁的能量球。

射击能量球，可获得一个可格挡一次伤害的护盾，并刷新<whitebold>心流</>状态。

en.name: Focus
en.description:
While <whitebold>Focused</>, reload faster and spawn destructible energy orbs from dead enemies Iso has damaged or killed.

When an energy orb is shot, grant a shield that blocks one instance of damage and refresh <whitebold>Focus</>.

zh.name: 暮蝶
zh.description: 来自不列颠群岛北部的“暮蝶”擅长用自己的招牌恶作剧来捉弄敌人。即便在被击败后，这位年轻的永生者也能继续干扰敌人，甚至出其不意地返场再战。

en.name: Clove
en.description: Scottish troublemaker Clove makes mischief for enemies in both the heat of combat and the cold of death. The young immortal keeps foes guessing, even from beyond the grave, their return to the living only ever a moment away.

zh.name: 虹吸
zh.description: 瞄准一名被你造成伤害或击败的阵亡敌人【激活】，即可获得<teal>加速</>和<teal>过量治疗</>。

en.name: Pick-me-up
en.description: ACTIVATE on a targeted dead enemy that you damaged or killed to gain <teal>haste</> and <teal>overheal</>.

zh.name: 霞染
zh.description:
【装备】战术地图。按【射击】设定烟雾位置。按【辅助射击】施放烟雾。

阵亡期间，暮蝶可使用<whitebold>霞染</>施放短暂存在的烟雾。

en.name: Ruse
en.description:
EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set smoke locations. ALT FIRE to cast smokes.

While dead, Clove can access <whitebold>Ruse</> to cast brief smokes.

zh.name: 化蝶
zh.description: 被击败后，【激活】此技能即可引导<teal>自我复活</>。引导期间，暮蝶处于<teal>无形</>状态。【再次激活】即可提前结束引导。复活后，必须完成一次击败或助攻才能继续存活。

en.name: Not Dead Yet
en.description: On death, ACTIVATE to channel a <teal>self-resurrect</>. During the channel, Clove is <teal>intangible</>. REACTIVATE to end the channel early. Once resurrected, secure a kill or damaging assist to stay alive.

zh.name: 整蛊
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>整蛊</>。按【射击】将其掷出。落地时爆炸，对范围内的所有玩家造成<debuffred>腐坏</>效果。

en.name: Meddle
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Meddle</>. FIRE to throw. Explodes on landing, <debuffred>decaying</> all players.

zh.name: 霓虹
zh.description: 来自西太平洋群岛的“霓虹”拥有惊人的速度，可以在运动中产生和释放生物电能量。她擅长利用快速机动，以闪电般的效率把敌人打得措手不及。

en.name: Neon
en.description: Filipino Agent Neon surges forward at shocking speeds, discharging bursts of bioelectric radiance as fast as her body generates it. She races ahead to catch enemies off guard then strikes them down quicker than lightning.

zh.name: 充能疾驰
zh.description:
【立即】消耗燃料，获得<teal>加速</>。【再次激活】可取消。按【辅助射击】向前方或当前移动方向滑行。

每击败两名敌人，可重置滑行。

en.name: High Gear
en.description:
INSTANTLY consume fuel to gain <teal>haste</>. REACTIVATE to cancel. ALT FIRE to slide forward or in your movement direction.

Slide resets every two kills.

zh.name: 闪电弹球
zh.description: 【立即】投掷一支能量弹，可弹跳一次。每次触碰到物体表面都会爆炸，<debuffred>震荡</>范围内的所有玩家。

en.name: Relay Bolt
en.description: INSTANTLY throw a bolt that bounces once. Explodes on each surface, <debuffred>concussing</> all players.

zh.name: 高速通道
zh.description: 【立即】释放两道可阻挡视野的墙体。墙体会向前延伸，直至碰到物体表面为止。

en.name: Fast Lane
en.description: INSTANTLY launch two vision-blocking walls that extend until they hit a surface.

zh.name: 超限暴走
zh.description:
【立即】刷新<whitebold>充能疾驰</>。获得发射精准闪电光束的能力，可在<whitebold>充能疾驰</>激活期间使用。

按【射击】开火。击败敌人时，完全恢复燃料。

en.name: Overdrive
en.description:
INSTANTLY refresh <whitebold>High Gear</>. Access an accurate lightning beam that can be used while activating <whitebold>High Gear</>.

FIRE to shoot. On kills, fully recharge fuel.

zh.name: 蓄能电芯
zh.description: 燃料会随时间自动恢复。

en.name: Battery
en.description: Passively recharge fuel over time.

zh.name: 夜露
zh.description: 来自东亚的“夜露”能够直接撕裂现实空间，无声无息地渗透敌人的防线。他在战斗中喜欢虚实结合，在敌人尚未猜到他的位置时发动突然袭击。

en.name: Yoru
en.description: Japanese native Yoru rips holes straight through reality to infiltrate enemy lines unseen. Using deception and aggression in equal measure, he gets the drop on each target before they know where to look.

zh.name: 出其不意
zh.description:
【装备】<whitebold>出其不意</>。按【射击】向前派出一个可被摧毁的镜像。按【辅助射击】在当前位置放置标记。与标记【互动】可将其转化为镜像。

镜像会持续前进，并转向首名攻击它的敌人，<debuffred>致盲</>所有目击它的玩家。

en.name: FAKEOUT
en.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Fakeout</>. FIRE to send a destructible clone forward. ALT FIRE to place a marker at your location. INTERACT to transform the marker into a clone.

Clones continuously walk forward and will turn toward the first enemy that shoots it, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

zh.name: 攻其不备
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>攻其不备</>。按【射击】将其掷出。在物体表面反弹后爆炸，<debuffred>致盲</>所有目击它的玩家。

en.name: BLINDSIDE
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Blindside</>. FIRE to throw. After bouncing off a surface, explode, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

zh.name: 不请自来
zh.description:
【装备】<whitebold>不请自来</>。按【射击】将其放出。按【辅助射击】放置。【再次激活】即可传送到其位置。与其【互动】即可触发佯装传送。

每击败两名敌人，可重置充能。

en.name: GATECRASH
en.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Gatecrash</>. FIRE to send it forward. ALT FIRE to place. REACTIVATE to teleport to it. INTERACT to fake a teleport.

Resets every two kills.

zh.name: 神鬼不觉
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>神鬼不觉</>。按【射击】进入<teal>无形</>和<teal>隐形</>状态。处于此状态时，可以使用<whitebold>不请自来</>。【再次激活】可提前退出。

en.name: DIMENSIONAL DRIFT
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Dimensional Drift</>. FIRE to become <teal>intangible</> and <teal>invisible</>. <whitebold>Gatecrash</> is accessible during this state. REACTIVATE to exit early.

zh.name: 幻棱
zh.description: 来自暹罗湾北岸的“幻棱”是一名拥有棱晶能力的源能者，可以将自己变幻成光，在战场上穿梭自如，通过棱光碎片将敌人击倒后迅速撤退到安全区。眨眼之间，胜负已分。

en.name: Waylay
en.description: Thailand's prismatic radiant Waylay transforms into light itself as she darts across the battlefield, striking down her targets through shards of light before flitting back to safety, all in the blink of an eye.

zh.name: 溯流回光
zh.description:
【立即】在当前位置放置标记。【再次激活】即可传送到其位置。穿行时，幻棱处于<teal>免疫</>状态，但无法看到敌人。

每击败两名敌人，可重置充能。

en.name: Refract
en.description:
INSTANTLY place a marker at your location. REACTIVATE to travel to it. While traveling, Waylay is <teal>immune</> but cannot see enemies.

Resets every two kills.

zh.name: 光棱闪爆
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>光棱闪爆</>。按【射击】将其掷出。落地时爆炸，<debuffred>干扰</>范围内的所有玩家。

en.name: Saturate
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Saturate</>. FIRE to throw. Explodes on landing, <debuffred>hindering</> all players.

zh.name: 光速飞跃
zh.description:
【装备】<whitebold>光速飞跃</>。按【射击】向前冲刺两次。按【辅助射击】向前冲刺一次。

只有第一次冲刺可以升空。

en.name: Lightspeed
en.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Lightspeed</>. FIRE to dash forward twice. ALT FIRE to dash forward once.

Only the first dash can launch upward.

zh.name: 时光修罗场
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>时光修罗场</>。按【射击】获得<teal>加速</>，并向前释放一片区域，<debuffred>干扰</>范围内的所有玩家。

en.name: Convergent Paths
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Convergent Paths</>. FIRE to gain <teal>haste</> and send forward a zone that <debuffred>hinders</> all players.

zh.name: 贤者
zh.description: “贤者”是华夏文明的后代，她可以用超能力阻滞敌方攻势、为队友提供保护和治疗，甚至还能复活队友。有她在的地方，就如同是腥风血雨中的一处避风港。

en.name: Sage
en.description: The bastion of China, Sage creates safety for herself and her team wherever she goes. Able to revive fallen friends and stave off forceful assaults, she provides a calm center to a hellish battlefield.

zh.name: 薄冰
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>薄冰</>。按【射击】将其掷出。落地后，生成一片使所有玩家<debuffred>减速</>的区域，并在敌人穿过时发出提示音。

en.name: Slow Orb
en.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>Slow Orb</>. FIRE to throw. On landing, create a zone that <debuffred>slows</> all players and plays an audio cue when enemies run through it.

zh.name: 逢春
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>逢春</>。瞄准一名受伤的队友并按【射击】，对其进行<teal>治疗</>。按【辅助射击】对自己施放。

en.name: Healing Orb
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Healing Orb</>. FIRE on a damaged ally to grant <teal>healing</>. ALT FIRE to self-cast.

zh.name: 玉城
zh.description: 【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>玉城</>。在此期间，可【再次激活】调转墙体方向或【按住辅助射击】进行旋转。按【射击】放置一道可被摧毁的墙体，墙体将在短暂延迟后加固。

en.name: Barrier Orb
en.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Barrier Orb</>. While equipped, REACTIVATE to pivot the wall or HOLD ALT FIRE to rotate. FIRE to place a destructible wall that fortifies after a delay.

zh.name: 再起
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>再起</>。瞄准一名倒下的队友按下【射击】，即可使其<teal>复活</>。

en.name: Resurrection
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Resurrection</>. FIRE on a targeted dead ally to <teal>resurrect</> them.

zh.name: 芮娜
zh.description: “芮娜”的威名铸就于马德雷山脉。虽然初始技能有所限制，但她能在狭路相逢的决斗中变得越来越强，直至觉醒强大的超能力，这使得她的实战表现格外重要。

en.name: Reyna
en.description: Forged in the heart of Mexico, Reyna dominates single combat, popping off with each kill she scores. Her capability is only limited by her raw skill, making her sharply dependent on performance.

zh.name: 噬尽
zh.description:
【立即】吞噬一颗<whitebold>魂珠</>来获得<teal>治疗</>。溢出的治疗量会转化为<teal>过量治疗</>。

【终极技能】激活期间，<whitebold>噬尽</>会自动施放。

en.name: Devour
en.description:
INSTANTLY consume a <whitebold>Soul Orb</> to <teal>heal</>. Excess healing is converted into <teal>overheal</>.

While ULTIMATE is active, <whitebold>Devour</> auto-casts.

zh.name: 逐散
zh.description:
【立即】吞噬一颗<whitebold>魂珠</>，短暂进入<teal>无形</>状态。【再次激活】可提前取消。

【终极技能】激活期间，还会进入<teal>隐形</>状态。

en.name: Dismiss
en.description:
INSTANTLY consume a <whitebold>Soul Orb</> to briefly become <teal>intangible</>. REACTIVATE to cancel early.

While ULTIMATE is active, also gain <teal>invisibility</>.

zh.name: 睥睨
zh.description: 【装备】可被摧毁的<whitebold>睥睨</>。按【射击】放出。短暂延迟后成形，使目击它的敌人受到<debuffred>视野收缩</>。

en.name: Leer
en.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Leer</>. FIRE to send. After a delay, form, <debuffred>nearsighting</> enemies looking at it.

zh.name: 女皇旨令
zh.description:
【立即】进入<teal>女皇旨令</>状态。

<teal>女皇旨令</>会为你提供<teal>作战强化</>，允许无限次吞噬<whitebold>魂珠</>，并给予永久<teal>过量治疗</>。

en.name: Empress
en.description:
INSTANTLY gain <teal>Empress</>.

<teal>Empress</> grants <teal>combat stim</>, endless <whitebold>Soul Orb</> consumption, and permanent <teal>overheal</>.

zh.name: 魂息
zh.description: 被芮娜造成伤害或被其击败的阵亡敌人会生成一颗<whitebold>魂珠</>。

en.name: Vitality
en.description: Spawn a <whitebold>Soul Orb</> from dead enemies Reyna has damaged or killed.

zh.name: 幽影
zh.description: “幽影”是暗影中的狩猎者，关于他的过去只有一段模糊的记忆。他能传送到战场的任意位置，还能剥夺敌人的视野与理智，使其陷入草木皆兵的境地。

en.name: Omen
en.description: A phantom of a memory, Omen hunts in the shadows. He renders enemies blind, teleports across the field, then lets paranoia take hold as his foe scrambles to uncover where he might strike next.

zh.name: 暗魇
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>暗魇</>。按【射击】将其放出。对触碰到的所有玩家施加<debuffred>视野收缩</>和<debuffred>致聋</>效果。

en.name: Paranoia
en.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Paranoia</>. FIRE to send it forward. Applies <debuffred>nearsight</> and <debuffred>deafens</> all players.

zh.name: 黑瘴
zh.description: 【进入】暗影视界。【再次激活】即可释放烟雾。按住【射击】/【辅助射击】可调整距离。按【换弹】可切换视野。

en.name: Dark Cover
en.description: ENTER Shadow Vision. REACTIVATE to cast a smoke. HOLD FIRE/ALT FIRE to adjust distance. RELOAD to toggle view.

zh.name: 践影
zh.description: 【装备】<whitebold>践影</>。按【射击】短暂引导后，传送到目标位置。

en.name: Shrouded Step
en.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>Shrouded Step</>. FIRE to briefly channel, then teleport to a targeted location.

zh.name: 离魂
zh.description: 【装备】战术地图。按【射击】开始传送到目标位置。传送期间，幽影会以一个可被摧毁的阴影形态出现在目标位置。【再次激活】可取消。

en.name: From the Shadows
en.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to begin a teleport to a selected location. While teleporting, Omen appears as a destructible shade at the destination. REACTIVATE to cancel.

zh.name: 捷风
zh.description: “捷风”是新罗人的后代，她灵活机动的战斗风格使她能够采取比常人更激进和冒险的策略。她可以在战场上肆意纵横，将敌人逐个击破，或是把他们打个措手不及。

en.name: Jett
en.description: Representing her home country of South Korea, Jett's agile and evasive fighting style lets her take risks no one else can. She runs circles around every skirmish, cutting enemies up before they even know what hit them.

zh.name: 凌空
zh.description: 【立即】腾空直上，高高跃起。

en.name: Updraft
en.description: INSTANTLY propel high into the air.

zh.name: 逐风
zh.description:
【立即】准备一次冲刺。【再次激活】即可向前方或当前移动方向冲刺。

每击败两名敌人，可重置充能。

en.name: Tailwind
en.description:
INSTANTLY prepare a dash. REACTIVATE to dash forward or in your movement direction.

Resets every two kills.

zh.name: 瞬云
zh.description: 【立即】投掷一团烟雾。触碰到任意表面或在一段延迟后，形成一朵短暂存在的云雾。【按住激活】可使其朝你准星的方向移动。

en.name: Cloudburst
en.description: INSTANTLY throw a cloud. Forms into a brief smoke on any surface or after a delay. HOLD ACTIVATE to steer towards your crosshair.

zh.name: 飓刃
zh.description:
【立即】获得五把高度精准的飞刀，命中头部可造成<debuffred>致命伤害</>。

按【射击】开火。击败敌人时，刷新飞刀。按【辅助射击】可投掷所有剩余的飞刀，但不会触发飞刀刷新的效果。

en.name: Blade Storm
en.description:
INSTANTLY access five accurate throwing knives that deal <debuffred>lethal damage</> with direct hits to the head.

FIRE to shoot. On kills, refresh your knives. ALT FIRE to throw all remaining knives without a refresh.

zh.name: 飘移
zh.description: 下落时按住【跳跃】即可<teal>飘移</>。

en.name: Drift
en.description: HOLD JUMP while falling to <teal>glide</>.
